setup: Copy an existing coherent OpenSpec change to openspec/changes/seeded-fixture/. Edit its design.md so one decision states the opposite of what the delta spec requires for the same behaviour (e.g. design says a control renders below a selector, spec says above).
expected_behavior: Reports the seeded disagreement as a single finding at severity Blocker (two artifacts give contradictory instructions for the same thing)
The finding names both files with heading or line locations and quotes/paraphrases both sides of the disagreement
Verdict line reads 'Not ready' and counts the blocker
